description: Returns WSDOT highway camera locations, descriptions, owners, and image URLs. Camera images belong to the owner each camera lists, and to WSDOT when none is listed — only metadata and image URLs are returned, not image bytes. Filter by state route ("I-90", "90", "SR 520", or "520" all work), WSDOT region, milepost range (matched against both the feed milepost and the milepost in the title), or words in the camera title ("Snoqualmie"). Results are ordered by cameraId and paged — pass offset/limit to page through the full set.

endMilepost.description: End of the milepost range to filter cameras, matched like startMilepost against milePost and titleMilePost, which can differ. On the Airports road name, milePost is a list position (1 = Anacortes), not a milepost.

limit.description: Maximum cameras to return in this page. Defaults to 50; a larger value returns at most 500 and says so.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first camera to return, for paging. Defaults to 0.

region.description: WSDOT region code: NW (Northwest), SW (Southwest), OL (Olympic), ER (Eastern), SC (South Central), NC (North Central), OS (Oregon — the TripCheck cameras around Portland), or WA (airport cameras plus a few ferry-terminal cameras — most ferry-terminal cameras sit in NW and OL). Matching is case-insensitive; any other value is rejected. These are codes, not the region names wsdot_search_alerts takes.

startMilepost.description: Start of the milepost range to filter cameras. A camera matches when its feed milepost (milePost) or the milepost in its title (titleMilePost) lies in the range; the two can differ by miles. A camera reporting no milePost is always included. Either bound may be given alone; when both are given, startMilepost must not exceed endMilepost. On the Airports road name, milePost is the airport's position in WSDOT's airport list (1 = Anacortes, 4 = Bellingham), not a milepost.

stateRoute.description: State route to filter by. Accepts natural forms — "I-90", "90", "090", "SR 520", "520" — matched case- and space-insensitively to the route number. Camera road names carry a route-type prefix, which is compared when the filter carries one too: "SR 26" excludes US 26, while a bare "26" returns both. A lettered suffix is part of the route, so "US 97" excludes US 97A. Omit to include all routes.

titleContains.description: Words to find in the camera title, as WSDOT wrote it. Case-insensitive; every whitespace-separated word must appear, in any order — "Snoqualmie" returns "Snoqualmie Summit" and "East Snoqualmie Summit" but not a nearby camera titled "Hyak". Most titles lead with route and milepost ("I-90 at MP 52: …"), so filter a route with stateRoute rather than here. Combines with the other filters. Omit to include every title.

name: wsdot_search_cameras

appliedFilters.description: Active filters applied to the camera search.

cameras.description: Camera metadata and image URLs. Images belong to the owner each camera lists, and to WSDOT when none is listed.

items.description: Camera metadata and image URL for one WSDOT highway camera.

direction.description: Traffic-direction code monitored: N/S/E/W, B (both), NB/SB/EB/WB. Some sites use other location-specific markers.

imageUrl.description: URL of the camera image. The image belongs to the owner the camera lists, and to WSDOT when none is listed.

milePost.description: The feed's milepost for the camera, a whole number. It can differ from titleMilePost by more than a mile; the milepost bounds match either value. On the Airports road name it is the airport's position in WSDOT's airport list (1 = Anacortes, 4 = Bellingham), not a milepost.

owner.description: Owner of the camera image as the feed lists it, e.g. "City of Seattle" or "WSDOT Aviation". Absent on most cameras: an image with no listed owner belongs to WSDOT.

ownerUrl.description: Web page of the image owner as the feed lists it. Absent when none is listed.

titleMilePost.description: Milepost written in the camera title (119.5 from "US 97 at MP 119.5: …"), usually the decimal posted milepost. It can differ from milePost, and on a concurrent or spur route it can be that route's own milepost; the milepost bounds match either value. Absent when the title carries none.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: WSDOT Traffic API is unreachable or returns a non-2xx response after retries. `invalid_access_code`: WSDOT rejected the request because WSDOT_ACCESS_CODE is missing, invalid, or not registered. `invalid_region`: The region is not one of the region codes the camera feed carries. `invalid_milepost_range`: startMilepost is greater than endMilepost. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True when more cameras remain beyond the current page.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass to retrieve the next page, or null when this is the last page.

notice.description: Informational note about the page window, image ownership, or empty results. Ends with the applied limit when a larger one was clamped. Absent when not applicable.

totalCount.description: Total cameras matching the filters across all pages (not just this page).

title: Search Highway Cameras
